violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed black discoloration on the cutting blade of the can opener
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO BEGIN CLEANING THE CAN OPENER. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF TO CLEAN AFTER EVERY USE MOVING FORWARD.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING FOODS NOT HOT HOLDING CORRECTLY: A) COMMERCIAL CHICKEN NUGGETS: 118F-131F, B) COMMERCIAL MASHED POTATOES: 89F- 113F, C) COMMERCIAL/SLICED TURKEY: 118F-132F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT AND STAFF TO REHEAT TO 165F.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) SPRAY BOTTLE FOR WATER USED FOR PRETZELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL THE BOTTLE. ARMSTRONG ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 11/22/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED CUSTODIAL STAFF TO HANG THE MOP UP TO ALLOW AIR DRYING AFTER USE.

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed the ceiling panels in the dry storage area not constructed to be smooth and easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS SHOWED THE MANAGER THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE KITCHEN CEILING PANELS AND DRY STORAGE AREA CEILING PANELS. WHEN THE SCHOOL UNDERGOES A RENOVATION, THE DRY STORAGE AREA SHALL HAVE WASHABLE CEILING PANELS.
